article.headline: Shesterkin makes 26 saves in Rangers' 3-1 victory over Panthers
article.description: — Adam Sykora broke a scoreless tie early in the third period and Igor Shesterkin made 26 saves and the New York Rangers defeated the Florida Panthers 3-1 on Sunday.
article.linkText: Shesterkin makes 26 saves in Rangers' 3-1 victory over Panthers

images.name: Florida Panthers vs. New York Rangers: Game Highlights
images.caption: Florida Panthers vs. New York Rangers: Game Highlights

article.story: NEW YORK -- — Adam Sykora broke a scoreless tie early in the third period and Igor Shesterkin made 26 saves and the New York Rangers defeated the Florida Panthers 3-1 on Sunday. Sykora, a rookie who was a second-round pick in 2022, scored his second goal of the season at 5:10, tipping Adam Fox's shot past Panthers goaltender Sergei Bobrovsky. Conor Sheary then scored his fifth of the season — on a short-handed breakaway — at 11:14 before Fox added an empty-netter at 16:06. Sykora also scored in the Rangers' 6-1 win against Chicago on Friday. The Rangers are just 11-18-7 at home this season. Florida's Mackie Samoskevich scored with 40.2 seconds left to end Shesterkin's shutout bid. New York nearly scored late in the second when Mika Zibanejad’s shot with 1:35 left skittered along the goal line before Panthers defenseman Gustav Forsling cleared it out. Florida appeared to take the lead at 3:22 of the third when Matthew Tkachuk scored on a breakaway, but the Rangers challenged and the play was ruled offside. Florida was coming off a 5-2 loss at the New York Islanders on Saturday in which Tkachuk scored both goals. Up next Panthers: host Ottawa on Tuesday. Rangers: host New Jersey on Tuesday. ------ AP NHL: https://apnews.com/hub/nhl
